description: Count words, characters (graphemes), and lines in a block of text.
test_source:
defmodule TextTools.WordCountTest do
  def run do
    StreamData.string(:printable, max_length: 60)
    |> Enum.take(200)
    |> Enum.each(fn s ->
      %{"words" => w, "chars" => c, "lines" => l} = TextTools.WordCount.run(%{"text" => s})
      true = c == String.length(s)
      true = l >= 1
      true = w >= 0 and w <= c + 1
    end)

    %{"words" => 2, "chars" => 11, "lines" => 1} = TextTools.WordCount.run(%{"text" => "hello world"})
    %{"lines" => 3} = TextTools.WordCount.run(%{"text" => "a\nb\nc"})
    :ok
  end
end
